description: Ministry of Defence - United Nations Security Council Resolution (UN Scr) 1373 - Regulation No. 01 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette content is an amendment to a list of designated persons, groups, and entities under the United Nations Regulations. It is a legal/regulatory update issued under the authority of THE UNITED NATIONS ACT, NO. 45 OF 1968. The content involves modifying a legal instrument (the list) for counter-terrorism purposes, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) concerning regulations, statutory instruments, and legal amendments. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized non-legal categories.
